hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: Custom AMM curve hook for fixed-rate Principal Token (PT) trading using a Pendle-style yield curve. Handles its own swap math via beforeSwap with delta returns, blocks direct PoolManager liquidity ops, optionally rehypothecates idle liquidity into ERC4626 vaults, and maintains a TWAP oracle for logarithmic implied rates. Swaps are permanently disabled after PT maturity.
